_README: Optional, and entirely keyless - this is where you paste prices no free feed carries.
Key each entry by gamePk (shown on the game card). Anything you leave out is skipped;
the model still publishes its own fair line for every market below either way.
f5          first five innings: moneyline both sides, and/or a total
nrfi        no run in the first inning: yes and no prices
team_totals per-team run totals, keyed by team abbreviation
Delete the example or leave it - unknown gamePks are ignored.
